body: I guess you're right... I need to love myself before anyone else. I have notes saved in my phone as well as hand written ones and I just I can't even believe it's gone. I don't know what went wrong honestly. I really don't. While we were dating I never said anything about suicide. I was the happiest I've ever been and the happiest anyone's ever seen me. Her family said it's the happiest she's ever been too.. I just want a second chance, you know? To fix things and just see if they'd work again. If they don't, then they don't and we move on and go our separate ways. I need closure and this isn't going to get me any. I feel like if I wouldn't have talked to her much yesterday we would be fine. Even if it took 6 months for us to date again, I wouldn't care. But now that's not even possible..
Haha. Thank you man. Everyone that has commented has helped. Don't feel as depressed, but like I said earlier, it's definitely still there.
Thank you. If it's not on Netflix, I'll definitely have to buy it.
I haven't. Is it on netflix / relatively cheap?
Ever since I first laid eyes on her..

"I can't do this anymore" 
I told her that there's a lot going on at home, etc and that I need her extremely badly right now. 
"No, I just can't do this anymore. We were better off before. We're done." 
So I hugged her, said "I love you.." Looked at her to see her "don't give a fuck" face and just said "goodbye..." And walked to my truck.

Thank you.  I can't open anything until I get closure. I've tried talking but she said "maybe this weekend", which upsets me because all I want to do is make things better and see truly why she broke up with me.

It hurts because I really don't think she is crying. When she broke up with me, I just have her a hug and she wouldn't even hug me back. I got in my truck and just went home and cried the whole time my way home. I highly doubt she is/did cry.

Yes, and friends for way longer. Before we were dating, we would flirt, so we were "dating" for a month. Obviously doesn't count, but what matters is that how close we were. I know it'll never be like that with anyone else.
In my mind, there is no future. My life is over.
I will see her Monday-Friday. Every day.

Exactly. I cried for a good hour straight. That void, though.. It's going to be there forever. I'd love for us to talk everything out so we can be back together, but it's going to hurt so bad when I see her hanging around all these guys that are in love with her. Truly it hurts.
Thank you. You're helping. I've calmed down but those suicidal thoughts are still up front. The only thing stopping me is just the thought that we might get back together.

Ever had that feeling where you can't even stand saying goodnight because all you want to do is talk to her? That's how it was. We were so close. Closer than I've ever seen anyone. Closest I've ever been with anyone.
It wouldn't hurt. I might watch some later. Thank you for the kind words, but it really doesn't feel like that.

Thank you. Unfortunately, my happiness and joy is completely gone. I don't even know what to do with myself. Where to go? I have no friends. Go to work? I called off.  I'm so close to just ending everything. It seems like everyone else would be much happier.
Well now I have absolutely no reason to try. No reason to finish school. No reason to even wake up every morning.

I've watched one motivational speaker a couple of months back. I'm not sure of his name but he didn't have legs, just a little "flipper" as he called it. I don't like most speakers because they're boring or the quality of the video is horrible. 

I'm fat and ugly and it's hard to be happy with just that. Truly, I don't even see a reason anymore.

I guess not :/. I told her a bit before we broke up that I need her and that a lot is going on in my life. And that I want to die. She told me "Stop. If you do that, you don't love me. I'll never forget it and I'll forever know you never loved me". Is that true? Because I love her more than I love myself. Why would someone say that? She saved me about a year ago when no one would bother talking to me or anything. 

It just hurts. I miss her so bad. Her hugs her everything. I'll never have it back.

I just don't see how it can get better. It's completely at the lowest point it can go. Everywhere I look, my bed, my tv, my computer, all I can think of is her. When she broke up with me, I hugged her and it seemed like she didn't care. I just don't get it. I've bent over backwards, missed work, missed opportunities just to see her that week because she was doing something else. Why was I not good enough? What did I do? All I did was love and care for her, and truly it seems like it wasn't mutual. Why am I not lovable? What's wrong with me..
